detail: Started from exact v1.2 integration commit 0f37245d9e6b446b69eb4c9debe5fc29254153ed in a clean isolated lane. Existing Review Inbox files were concurrently modified in the canonical checkout, so the implementation narrowed to a new leaf companion tool.
The first focused run exposed raw control characters being normalized before validation. Validation was moved before normalization and the adversarial case then passed.
Commit eb6ed6bdced1b5165946bc7aa3ced586384d54c1 adds the local Collaboration Room, decision-draft schema and deterministic core, contract, manifest, documentation and focused tests.

Real in-app browser rendering and clicks passed at the default desktop viewport and a 390 by 844 narrow viewport. Scenario, actor, refusal, valid draft, clear, hold and Review Inbox route behaviors were observed; no console errors or horizontal overflow were observed.

The first broad Workshop gate rejected unsupported lifecycle vocabulary for state owner and cleanup. The contract was changed to the exact Workshop verifier values browser and automatic; verify.js and verify-plus then passed.

Focused room checks passed 68 cases; Review Inbox passed 23 assertions and its 14-control seam; all 25 Fabric scripts passed; all ten required Workshop commands passed; verify.js retained 22 warning lines.

The room proves visualization and local draft behavior only. AI and Mirror live presence, authentication, persistence, provider calls, candidate generation or execution, installation, integration, promotion, learning and CANON remain unperformed or explicitly unavailable.
After browser reload the ephemeral record returned to NO DRAFT and the page stated that nothing had been submitted, saved or authorized.
